title: Weighted mix of an expanding trace list
summary: Symbols are added to an expanding list of traces, and a query mixes them with weights given by the exponential of a similarity, normalized to one.
core_idea: Mix an expanding list of traces with normalized exponential similarity weights.

state.name: pellwick
state.meaning: Expanding list of traces, one entry per symbol.

learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: A unique trace is read after one write.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: Weighted mixing of traces is common.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: Weights do not sum to one.

toy_example.python:
import json
import math
z = [math.exp(v) for v in (1.0, 0.0)]
print(json.dumps({'z0': round(z[0] / sum(z), 9)}))
